title: Slovakian Beef and Dumplings
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring tender beef and fluffy dumplings, all baked in the oven to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, warm milk, and butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
On a floured surface, use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dumpling circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Place the dumplings in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the tops of the dumplings with a little bit of oil and sprinkle with salt.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until they are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with the beef gravy spooned over the top.
